---
title: "MLB Ballpark Leaderboard & Rankings"
subtitle: "Statcast 2026 Home Run Factor by Stadium"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
---

```{r}
#| label: setup-rankings
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(plotly)

parks <- fromJSON("data/park_dimensions_factors.json") |>
  as_tibble()

parks_2026 <- parks |>
  filter(season == 2026, split == "All") |>
  arrange(desc(index_hr)) |>
  mutate(
    rank = row_number(),
    category = case_when(
      index_hr >= 105 ~ "HR Friendly (>105)",
      index_hr <= 95  ~ "Pitcher Friendly (<95)",
      TRUE            ~ "Neutral (95-105)"
    ),
    cat_color = case_when(
      index_hr >= 105 ~ "#ef4444",
      index_hr <= 95  ~ "#3b82f6",
      TRUE            ~ "#94a3b8"
    )
  )
```

## Stadium Home Run Factor Rankings (2026)

A score of **100** represents MLB average. Stadiums with an index above 100 boost home run production above league average, while stadiums below 100 suppress home runs.

::: {.glass-card}
```{r}
#| label: plot-rankings-bar
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

p_rank <- plot_ly(
  data = parks_2026,
  y = ~reorder(venue_name, index_hr),
  x = ~index_hr,
  type = "bar",
  orientation = "h",
  color = ~category,
  colors = c("HR Friendly (>105)" = "#ef4444", "Neutral (95-105)" = "#64748b", "Pitcher Friendly (<95)" = "#3b82f6"),
  text = ~paste0(index_hr, " (", team, ")"),
  textposition = "outside",
  hoverinfo = "text",
  hovertext = ~paste0(
    "<b>#", rank, " ", venue_name, "</b><br>",
    "Team: ", team, " (", league, ")<br>",
    "HR Factor: ", index_hr, "<br>",
    "Avg Fence Dist: ", avg_fence_distance, " ft<br>",
    "Elevation: ", elevation, " ft<br>",
    "Roof: ", roof
  )
) |>
  layout(
    title = list(
      text = "<b>2026 MLB Ballparks Ranked by Statcast Home Run Factor</b>",
      font = list(color = "#ffffff", size = 16)
    ),
    height = 800,
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor = "rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6)",
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Home Run Factor (100 = MLB Average)",
      gridcolor = "rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.4)",
      color = "#94a3b8",
      range = c(60, 145)
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "",
      gridcolor = "rgba(51, 65, 85, 0.2)",
      color = "#e2e8f0"
    ),
    legend = list(
      font = list(color = "#e2e8f0"),
      orientation = "h",
      y = 1.05
    )
  )

p_rank
```
:::

## Ballpark Profiles & Physical Specs

```{r}
#| label: rankings-cards
#| results: asis
#| echo: false

cat('<div class="row row-cols-1 row-cols-md-2 row-cols-lg-3 g-3">\n')

for (i in seq_len(nrow(parks_2026))) {
  row <- parks_2026[i, ]
  badge_class <- if (row$index_hr >= 105) {
    "badge bg-danger"
  } else if (row$index_hr <= 95) {
    "badge bg-primary"
  } else {
    "badge bg-secondary"
  }
  
  cat(sprintf('
  <div class="col">
    <div class="glass-card h-100" style="border-top: 3px solid %s;">
      <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start mb-2">
        <div>
          <span class="text-secondary small">#%d</span>
          <h5 class="text-white mb-0 mt-1">%s</h5>
          <small class="text-muted">%s &bull; %s (%s)</small>
        </div>
        <span class="%s fs-6">HR %d</span>
      </div>
      <div class="small text-secondary mt-3 pt-2 border-top border-dark font-monospace">
        <div>LF Line: <span class="text-light">%s ft</span> | CF: <span class="text-light">%s ft</span> | RF Line: <span class="text-light">%s ft</span></div>
        <div>Avg Fence: <span class="text-light">%s ft</span> | Max Wall: <span class="text-light">%s ft</span></div>
        <div>Elevation: <span class="text-light">%s ft</span> | Roof: <span class="text-light">%s</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>',
  row$cat_color,
  row$rank,
  row$venue_name,
  row$team,
  row$division,
  row$city,
  badge_class,
  row$index_hr,
  row$distance_lf_line,
  row$distance_cf,
  row$distance_rf_line,
  row$avg_fence_distance,
  row$height_highest,
  row$elevation,
  row$roof
  ))
}

cat('</div>\n')
```
